combo_label: Halloween × Silly English Things × Harry Potter

entries.clue: Cowardly boarhound slobbering about the gamekeeper's hut
Sticky green slime smeared on a rubber hand for effect
Slack-jawed and dim, from a northern dialect word meaning heed or sense
Flame-haired family of nine crammed into the Burrow
Black deposit a naked flame leaves on the lid of a lantern
Stout scissors a gardener snips woody stems with
Seafront hall of coin pushers, grabber claws and tuppenny clatter
Sneering pale-haired schoolmate, and a dragon in the stars
Tartan-clad vessel keeping tea warm halfway up a ramble
Hooded horror whose icy kiss can steal a soul outright
Knitted cover slipped over the brewing tea to keep the heat in
Round-eyed hunter that quarters a churchyard once the light goes
Male counterpart of a sorceress, in a word of Scots descent
Move in quick darts to and fro, silent and on thin black wings
